blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Regional labor confederation International Trade Union Confederation (ITUC)-Asia Pacific has urged the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) to reject groups it accuses of falsely claiming to represent Myanmar’s independent trade unions as Manila hosts a regional forum on migrant labor on Oct. 14 and Oct. 15. The Philippines is set to host the 19th Asean Forum on Migrant Labour (AFML), which will discuss the protection of migrant workers and ethical labor migration pathways.
